UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Student account profile with salted passcode verifier owned strictly by the authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Student name displayed in study chat.

gradeLevel.description: Student grade or class level (e.g. ថ្នាក់ទី ១២).

passcodeHash.description: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hex hash of the user passcode.

passcodeSalt.description: Random 16-byte hex salt used to hash the user passcode.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Non-sensitive student directory card visible to signed-in peers for adding friends and direct lesson chat.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

studentCode.description: Short uppercase identifier code derived from userId for easy friend lookup.

visibility.description: Directory visibility scope for signed-in students.

FriendConnection.title: FriendConnection
FriendConnection.description: Canonical friend request and accepted mutual friendship between two students.

participantIds.description: Sorted pair [minUid, maxUid] of the two students.

DirectLessonMessage.title: DirectLessonMessage
DirectLessonMessage.description: Private 1-on-1 direct message between accepted student friends with optional attached lesson document.

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: Shared study discussion room where students ask questions about lessons and documents.

creatorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the room.

name.description: Title of the study discussion room.

subjectTag.description: Subject or category label for the room.

visibility.description: Visibility scope required for shared study chat queries.

lastMessageText.description: Preview of the latest message posted in the room.

lastSenderName.description: Display name of the latest sender.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Message posted in a study room, optionally referencing a lesson document.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Student display name at send time.

senderGrade.description: Student grade level at send time.

text.description: Chat message text or lesson question.

attachedLessonType.description: Optional referenced lesson type (PDF, IMAGE, NOTE, DOCUMENT).

attachedLessonNote.description: Optional excerpt or study note from the referenced lesson.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user student account document storing name, grade level, and salted passcode hash.

/studentDirectory/{userId}.description: Public-to-signed-in-students profile directory for discovering peers and sending friend requests.

/friendConnections/{pairId}.description: Mutual friend connections and pending/accepted/declined friend requests keyed by sorted pairId.

/friendConnections/{pairId}/messages/{me.description: Private 1-on-1 lesson discussion messages between accepted friends.

/studyRooms/{roomId}.description: Shared study chat rooms for discussing lessons and documents.

/studyRooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId.description: Study chat messages within a room, with optional attached lesson document references.
